properties.name: Aimere
properties.notes: South-coast port of Ngada Regency, ~1 hour south of Bajawa; ASDP ferry to Waingapu (Sumba, Tue/Fri) and Kupang. Exact pier coordinates not found in sources; placed at a low-elevation coastal point inside Ngada near the described location.
sources: map:overture (Pelabuhan Aimere, Puskesmas, Polres, BRI cluster)

properties.name: Bajawa
properties.notes: Capital of Ngada Regency, cool highland town (~1,100-1,300 m) on the Trans-Flores highway; hotels, market, ATMs, some bike-ish parts. Coordinate is the mean of two independent web sources ~1.5 km apart.

properties.name: Bena
properties.notes: Ngada megalithic village 19 km south of Bajawa in Tiwuriwu village, Aimere district, at the foot of Inerie; proposed cultural checkpoint, agreement with the village council required before race day.

properties.name: Blidit
properties.notes: Last village before the Egon volcano trail, reached from Waigete (about 19 km east of Maumere on the highway) via an 8-9 km side road. A trip report gives the trailhead elevation as 788 m; this point was found by sampling the DEM along the Waigete-Egon line and picking the spot where elevation matches (786 m at 6.3 km from Waigete) -- an unusually good independent check for a hand-derived position. (Earlier component-distance figures of 16 km + 8 km did not reconcile with the ~26.4 km straight-line distance from Maumere to this point; corrected above.)

properties.name: Boawae
properties.notes: Main south-central town of Nagekeo Regency, on the northwest slope of Ebulobo volcano, on the Trans-Flores highway. Position corrected ~13.0 km to the Kantor Camat Boawae / Polsek Boawae cluster (Overture Maps place theme) from an earlier desk estimate that landed well away from any Boawae-named place.

properties.name: Bola
properties.notes: South-coast kecamatan capital, anchor of the optional 'Egon and the Bola coast' Ultra loop (Maumere -> Bola -> Watublapi -> Egon). Wikidata/GNS point (77 m) shifted ~1.5 km to a DEM-confirmed coastal flat (~1 m); that point in turn sat ~183 m into the sea against the geoBoundaries regency mask (a coastline-simplification artifact), so nudged onto the nearest on-land point.

properties.name: Borong
properties.notes: Capital of Manggarai Timur Regency, south-coast port town: market, hospital, banks, bus terminal, hotels (Gloria Hotel Toka Borong). Anchor for the Manggarai Timur interior loop (Ultra variant).

properties.name: Boru
properties.notes: Wulanggitang kecamatan capital on the Trans-Flores highway between Maumere and Larantuka; a handful of roadside restaurants and the PVMBG Lewotobi volcano observation post are nearby. Relevant only to Alternative B (the highway corridor through the Lewotobi hazard zone) -- concept A routes the course north of Lewotobi instead. ~8 km from the Lewotobi vents; see p-lewotobi-laki-laki / p-lewotobi-perempuan hazard notes before any use of this node on race day.

properties.name: Denge
properties.notes: Last village reachable by road/motorbike before the Wae Rebo trek (about 8 km, +700 m, 2.5-3 h on foot). Coordinates placed by interpolation from route descriptions (~6 km from Dintor, ~7-9 km from Wae Rebo) and cross-checked against the DEM; needs a field GPS fix.

properties.name: Detusoko
properties.notes: Highland district capital ~33 km/1,100 km north of Ende on the road to Moni; cool air, green rice terraces, a tourism village (Detusoko Barat) with homestays.

properties.name: Dintor
properties.notes: South-coast village in Desa Satar Ruwuk on the Wae Nakeng-Nangalili-Borik-Dintor-Denge coastal track. Coordinates are a reasoned placement from route descriptions (no named source pin found); flagged for scouting.

properties.name: Elar
properties.notes: Capital of Elar kecamatan, Manggarai Timur interior: camat office, health centre, schools only. Ultra-variant loop node between Borong and the north coast at Pota; tracks in this interior are unscouted.

properties.name: Ende
properties.notes: Largest town of central Flores, capital of Ende Regency, on the south coast under Iya volcano; full resupply, hospital, airport, Sukarno's 1934-38 exile town. Natural Earth's populated-place point for Ende sits 2.81 km south of this pin; kept as-is since Ende spans several km and the discrepancy reads as a town-centroid-definition difference (this pin is the harbour/centre area) rather than a relocation error.

properties.name: Gurusina
properties.notes: Ngada traditional village on the south-east flank of Inerie, rebuilt after the August 2018 fire; anchor for the Inerie full-circuit option (Bena -> Gurusina -> Sewowoto coast -> Aimere). Position from the Overture gazetteer entry 'Kampung Adat Gurusina', consistent with the curated POI p-gurusina.

properties.name: Iteng
properties.notes: Capital of Satar Mese kecamatan, on the south coast (a beach point is tagged at the village itself). Has a market (pasar Iteng), a Catholic parish, a health centre and schools -- the practical resupply between Todo and Ruteng.

properties.name: Kelimutu
properties.notes: Kelimutu National Park entrance gate (~1,234 m) and summit car park (~1,522 m), a 20-minute paved walk from the three crater lakes; the mandatory dawn checkpoint of the race. Booth opens 05:00.

properties.name: Koka
properties.notes: Twin-bay beach on the south coast, reached via an ~8 km side road off the Trans-Flores highway near Paga. No lodging found; day-stop / checkpoint only. Coordinates from a single beach-tourism source; DEM confirms a coastal position (~6 m).

properties.name: Labuan Bajo
properties.notes: Race start. Also the region's only airport (Komodo/Labuan Bajo Airport, IATA LBJ) and its busiest port (ferries, Komodo tour boats, Pelni). Fully geared tourist town: dive shops, ATMs, supermarkets, hospitals.

properties.name: Larantuka
properties.notes: Race finish town: capital of Flores Timur Regency, historic Portuguese-Catholic port under Ile Mandiri, host of the Semana Santa Holy Week procession. Also a port (ferries to Adonara, Solor, Lembata, Kupang) and near Gewayantana Airport (~9 km, see p-gewayantana-airport). One aggregator's decimal figure (-8.328844, 122.949401, 243 m -- clearly on the Ile Mandiri slope) was inconsistent with its own DMS figure on the same page; the DMS figure converts to this point, which the DEM confirms as coastal (13 m).

properties.name: Lela
properties.notes: Kecamatan capital between Sikka village and Maumere on the south-coast road; historic co-seat of the Sikka kingdom's Catholic mission. Coordinate is the Wikidata/GNS kecamatan centroid (139 m, a hillside position consistent with the road climbing away from the coast here).

properties.name: Liang Bua
properties.notes: The village and limestone cave ~14 km NW of Ruteng where Homo floresiensis was found (2003). Small vendor stalls at the site; no lodging confirmed.

properties.name: Mataloko
properties.notes: Golewa district capital on the Trans-Flores highway ~17 km ESE of Bajawa; St. Yohanes Berchmans minor seminary (European-style, colonial era) and the Mataloko geothermal field (20+ hot springs). Kemah Tabor retreat house nearby.

properties.name: Maukaro
properties.notes: North-coast sub-district (kecamatan) of Ende Regency, on the Flores Sea, bordering Nagekeo; fishing villages (a 'Kampung Nelayan Merah Putih' fisheries project is under way at Kobaleba beach). Nudged ~1.85 km to the Puskesmas Maukaro cluster (Overture Maps place theme). Route-concept.md groups 'Maukaro' with Nangaroro as a south-coast alternative toward Ende, but the only documented place of this name is this north-coast Ende sub-district; treated here as a north-coast alternative node per the task brief, flagged for the route designer to reconcile.

properties.name: Maumere
properties.notes: Capital of Sikka Regency and the largest town of the eastern half of the island: market, ATMs, hospital (RSUD dr. TC Hillers), bike-ish parts, hotels. Frans Seda Airport is 5 km out (see p-frans-seda-airport). Rebuilt after the 12 Dec 1992 earthquake and tsunami (see p-maumere-1992).

properties.name: Mbay
properties.notes: Administrative capital of Nagekeo Regency, on the Aesesa coastal plain (the largest rice-growing lowland on Flores), north coast. Desk position corrected ~17.3 km from an earlier unverified placement to the Civic Center / RSU Aeramo hospital / Terminal Danga cluster of Mbay-named places (Overture Maps place theme, independent of the Wikipedia/blog sources below); still not a field GPS fix.

properties.name: Moni
properties.notes: Small highland hamlet at the foot of Kelimutu, ~50 km east of Ende; a dozen guesthouses and warungs, the usual overnight base for a dawn ascent to the crater lakes. An independent cross-check (Overture Maps place theme) finds a low-confidence cluster of Moni-named businesses (Daniel Lodge, Good Moni Cafe) averaging ~2.7 km east, toward the Kelimutu gate; Moni is a linear roadside village so this may reflect real village extent rather than a placement error. Left unmoved pending a real field/web check; if moved, the indicated target is roughly [121.847, -8.750].

properties.name: Nangaroro
properties.notes: South-coast district of Nagekeo Regency bordering Ende; farming and fishing villages (Tonggo etc.), grey-stone beaches; an alternative south-coast crossing from Boawae/Mbay toward Ende.

properties.name: Nggela
properties.notes: Lio ikat-weaving village on a coastal ridge (~180 m) 21 km east of Ende town, 1 km inland from the south coast; end anchor of the Central region, proposed cultural checkpoint per route-concept design rule 5.

properties.name: Paga
properties.notes: Small south-coast village directly on the Trans-Flores highway. Position corrected ~5.8 km east to a real 'Paga beach' / 'Paga Beach Bungalows' cluster (Overture Maps place theme); the earlier placement sat almost on top of Koka's coordinates (~0.5 km away), which this correction also resolves. Still needs a field GPS fix.

properties.name: Penggajawa
properties.notes: Coastal village in Nangapanda district, Ende Regency, on the Blue Stone (Batu Biru) beach, ~25 km west of Ende on the Bajawa-Ende road.

properties.name: Pota
properties.notes: North-coast village/port in Sambi Rampas kecamatan, Manggarai Timur: parish church, health centre, bank unit, schools. End of the west region's corridor; onward to Riung is the next agent's territory.

properties.name: Ranamese
properties.notes: Junction/rest stop by Ranamese crater lake in the Ruteng Nature Recreation Park, ~16 km from Ruteng on the road toward Manggarai Timur. A warung is reported at the lakeside car park.

properties.name: Reo
properties.notes: Old north-coast port town in Reok kecamatan: market, bank, gas station, health centre, mosque and church, a homestay (Reo Family Homestay). The port facility itself sits a few km west at the Wae Reo river mouth (see the matching POI).

properties.name: Riung
properties.notes: Fishing port and gateway village for the Seventeen Islands marine park; small shops and a market, several homestays/losmen serving divers and boat tourists. Coordinates hand-placed from the Riung Nature Reserve boundary and the north edge of Ngada Regency; needs a field GPS fix.
sources: map:overture (Riung hotel and marine park office cluster)

properties.name: Ruteng
properties.notes: Capital of Manggarai Regency, 1,168-1,188 m, cool highland town: hospital, market, banks, many hotels, served by Frans Sales Lega airport. Best full resupply of the whole west region.

properties.name: Sano Nggoang
properties.notes: Small village on the shore of the Sano Nggoang caldera lake, in the kecamatan of the same name. Basic kiosks only; homestays exist for lake visitors but capacity is small and unconfirmed. Anchor placed on the lake shore; the kecamatan capital is Werang 8 km north.

properties.name: Sewowoto (Ena Bhara beach)
properties.notes: Coastal hamlet and community-tourism beach (Pokdarwis Ena Bhara) at the foot of Inerie's southern slope; the low point of the Inerie full-circuit option before the coast road back to Aimere. Position from the Overture gazetteer; no independent record yet.

properties.name: Sikka
properties.notes: Seaside village on the south coast, seat of the old Sikka kingdom and site of the 1899 Portuguese-era church. Position corrected ~2.5 km to 'Gereja Tua, kampung Sikka' (the old church itself, Overture Maps place theme) -- a direct name match to the landmark this village is defined by -- from an earlier hand correction based on a Wikidata polygon centroid. Still needs a field GPS fix.

properties.name: Soa
properties.notes: Turelelo-Soa Airport (BJW), the airfield serving Bajawa, ~23.5 km north of Bajawa town; the Soa sub-district also holds the Mengeruda/Mangeruda hot springs.

properties.name: Talibura
properties.notes: Easternmost and largest kecamatan of Sikka Regency, on the Flores Sea coast approaching the Flores Timur border; has a mangrove coast (Desa Darat Pantai). Two Wikidata entries for 'Talibura' disagree by several km and both landed inland/uphill on the DEM; this point is a hand correction to the nearest coastal flat matching the north-coast description. A later independent cross-check (Overture Maps place theme) adds a third disagreement: 'Kantor Camat Talibura' sits 8.61 km away and a conflicting school cluster ('SMP Negeri 1 Talibura') sits 2.48 km away, and the two candidates disagree with each other. Left unmoved rather than desk-guessing between three disagreeing candidates; needs a field GPS fix, not another desk correction. Update: an offline Overture cross-check found a coherent nine-point administrative/school/church cluster on the north coast (centred on Kantor Camat Talibura, ~4.6 km across); the anchor was moved to that cluster's centre and confidence raised from unverified to approximate.

properties.name: Todo
properties.notes: Former seat of the Manggarai kingdom; day-trip village, no lodging found. Confirmed by five independent Overture/OSM points (church, clinic, tourism tag, school) clustered within 1.5 km.

properties.name: Wae Rebo
properties.notes: Cultural checkpoint; UNESCO Asia-Pacific award village. All visitors sleep and eat inside the mbaru niang under the village's own homestay system -- a race stop here means income for the community by design. Requires an agreement with the village council (see cultural_protocol on the matching POI).

properties.name: Waiterang
properties.notes: North-coast dive village east of Maumere (Waigete kecamatan), on the same stretch as the Wodong dive sites; a small dive resort operates here. No dedicated source pins Waiterang itself; position taken from two closely agreeing Wodong anchorage fixes 08°36.391'S 122°28.498'E / 08°36.124'S 122°28.692'E on the same bay.

properties.name: Watublapi
properties.notes: Hillside ikat-weaving hamlet (Dusun Watublapi, Desa Kajowair, Kecamatan Hewokloang), about 18 km / 30 min inland-south-east of Maumere. No source gives coordinates for the hamlet itself; placed at the Hewokloang kecamatan centroid as a proxy (185 m, plausibly hillside). Needs a field GPS fix.

properties.name: Werang
properties.notes: Capital of Sano Nggoang kecamatan: parish church (Santo Klaus), police post, camat office, schools. The practical resupply stop after the lake.

properties.name: Wolojita
properties.notes: District (kecamatan) centre and ikat-weaving village on the south Lio coast, between Jopu and Nggela.
